meta_description: lizakoshy on April 16, 2026: "#BofAPartner I want to hear every “no” as a “go”, because mastering the art of continuing, learning from the lessons and showing up to play again is where the real win lives. Thank you to @bankofamerica, the Official Bank of U.S. Soccer and the FIFA World Cup 2026™ for reminding me that staying in the game is how you get the win. What would you like the power to do?".
